project_title: Smart Quran Memorization Circle Management System (CPIT-499, King Abdulaziz University)

design_philosophy.core_concept: Sacred Precision meets Modern Analytics. Clean Islamic architectural minimalism combined with tactical dashboard ergonomics.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Islamic geometric harmony with high-density data analytics.
Mobile-First Teacher Flow: 360px narrow viewport optimization for low-friction live recitation logging without horizontal scrolling.
Dual-Script Ergonomics: Native RTL Arabic (default) and LTR English seamlessly switchable at runtime with mirrored layouts and fluid typography.
Data Clarity & Gamification: Four distinct, unblended leaderboards, EWMA Momentum tracking, 30 Juz interactive journey map, and weighted error tagging.

language_and_direction.switcher_requirement: Floating or top-nav toggle present on all screens (ar/en) modifying `dir` on HTML element and applying corresponding font stack and mirrored CSS flex/grid classes.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.quran_verse: font-quran text-lg sm:text-2xl leading-loose text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-100

responsive_and_mobile.teacher_logging_mobile_rule: The Teacher Recitation Session Logging screen MUST fit and function perfectly at 360px viewport width. Zero horizontal overflow (`overflow-x-hidden` on parent container, compact multi-step or single-column stacked forms, touch-friendly min 44px chip buttons for error tags and attendance).

layout_and_grids.student_dashboard: Bento grid mode B (High Density Data). Columns: 1 on mobile, 2 on tablet, 4 on desktop. Includes Mastery Gauge (0-100 radial/arc chart), EWMA Momentum (pages/week chart), Precision score, Consistency percentage, and Review Depth index.
layout_and_grids.leaderboards: Four distinct tabbed leaderboards (1. Momentum, 2. Precision, 3. Consistency, 4. Review Depth). NEVER combine into a single merged score.
layout_and_grids.juz_journey_map: Interactive 30-Juz visual grid/timeline card with color-coded status (Mastered, In Progress, Needs Review, Not Started).
layout_and_grids.teacher_logging_view: Vertical tight stream with sticky bottom/header quick submit bar, segmented control attendance picker, Surah & Ayah range pickers, tap-to-add error tag chips with Ayah reference inputs.

auth_flows.staff_login: Standard Email + Password authentication card with role selector preview or quick demologin buttons.
auth_flows.student_login: Dedicated separate screen with prominent 8-character teacher-generated access code input box (large centered letter-spacing font) with quick access demo codes.

testing_convention.rule: Every button, link, tab, input, dialog trigger, leaderboard row, card metric, and error tag MUST have a descriptive kebab-case `data-testid` attribute.

implementation_rules: Ensure default direction is RTL and default language is Arabic ('ar'). Toggle to English ('en') must change document direction to LTR dynamically.
Integrate Lucide or Radix icons. Do NOT use standard AI emoji characters (🤖, 🧠, 💡) for navigation or dashboard badges.
Teacher logging screen MUST be testable and visually optimal down to 360px viewport width without breaking horizontal layout.
Ensure all 4 weighted error tags are clearly distinct visually (Memory gap, Linkage error, Tajweed error, Self-correction).
Ensure the four leaderboards are distinct tabs or sub-views (Momentum, Precision, Consistency, Review Depth) and never merged into one single rank.

Include pre-seeded sample data for KAU CPIT-499 demo scenarios across System Admin, Circle Admin, Teacher, and Student roles. One-click role switching is a DEVELOPMENT-ONLY convenience: it must be compiled out of a production build, never shipped to a deployment a real user can reach.
All interactive elements must carry `data-testid` attributes.
